name: snapread
description: SnapRead — AI-driven website summarizer powered by React, Express, and Gemini

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.netlify.json
